text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the day of the race, Sweep Tosho sees Kawakami Princess and a certain peer in the stands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In an effort to ensure that her magic will blow away everyone's "lame" attitudes, she vows to Zenno Rob Roy that she'll hold nothing back in the race ahead.
